# Lease of a rehearsal room

The parties to this lease are:

- Landlord: ⟦PERSON|Grant Pellover⟧.
- Tenant: ⟦ORG|Sable Chime Music Ltd⟧ (the Tenant).

## Grant

The landlord lets the rear rehearsal room at ⟦ADDRESS|32 Cresset Road, Nottingham⟧ for six months beginning on 1 December 2026. The lease includes use of the shared entrance and washroom. It gives no right to store equipment in the passage or to obstruct the emergency exit.

The rent is GBP 390 per month, payable in advance. Ordinary electricity use is included, but the tenant must obtain permission before installing a heater or other equipment requiring a separate circuit. The landlord will provide an inventory of the fixtures before occupation.

Grant of an additional storage area requires a written variation. No oral assurance by a caretaker changes the extent of the premises. The tenant must report water ingress promptly and allow reasonable access for inspection after notice.

The landlord, ⟦PERSON|Grant⟧, will hold one duplicate key for emergencies. That arrangement does not permit unannounced access for routine inspections. The parties will record the condition of the room when the lease ends and identify any disputed damage separately from ordinary wear.

**Signature block**

Landlord: ⟦PERSON|Grant Pellover⟧

Tenant's signatory: ⟦PERSON|Taryn Vossick⟧, director

Executed on 26 November 2026 under clause 11.2.
